info.title: Chokh
info.description: The HTTP API of a Chokh install, generated from the server's route table and schemas.

post.summary: What the tracker sends: a batch of pageviews and events from one page, read as JSON whatever its content type says.
post.x-chokh-who: Anybody.

post.summary: Events and identifies from your own server, with a key carrying write:events.
post.x-chokh-who: A session or a key with `write:events` on the site.

get.x-chokh-who: Anybody.

post.summary: The first account of an install registers itself and owns it; after that, an owner creates accounts.
post.x-chokh-who: Anybody, for the first account of an install; after that, a person who owns a team.

post.summary: Signs in with an address and a password and sets the session cookie.
post.x-chokh-who: Anybody.

post.summary: Ends the session this request carries.
post.x-chokh-who: Anybody signed in, or any key.

post.summary: Exchanges a token another application signed for a session, for that application's server.
post.x-chokh-who: Anybody.

get.summary: The same exchange for a person following a link: sets the cookie and redirects to `next`.
get.x-chokh-who: Anybody.
